verses.text: Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?

segments.text: Jehovah is my light and my salvation;
Whom shall I fear?
Jehovah is the strength of my life;
Of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.text: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, Even mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

segments.text: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh,
Even
mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

verses.text: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.

segments.text: Though a host should encamp against me,
My heart shall not fear:
Though war should rise against me,
Even then will I be confident.

verses.text: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.

segments.text: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after:
That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life,
To behold the beauty of Jehovah,
And to inquire in his temple.

verses.text: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion: In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me; He will lift me up upon a rock.

segments.text: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion:
In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me;
He will lift me up upon a rock.

verses.text: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.

segments.text: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me;
And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy;
I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.

verses.text: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

segments.text: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice:
Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.text: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.

segments.text: When thou saidst
, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee,
Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.

verses.text: Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

segments.text: Hide not thy face from me;
Put not thy servant away in anger:
Thou hast been my help;
Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.text: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then Jehovah will take me up.

segments.text: When my father and my mother forsake me,
Then Jehovah will take me up.

verses.text: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; And lead me in a plain path, Because of mine enemies.

segments.text: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah;
And lead me in a plain path,
Because of mine enemies.

verses.text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.

segments.text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries:
For false witnesses are risen up against me,
And such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.text: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.

segments.text: I had fainted

verses.text: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.
